issue.masthead: no. 158 · North Hollow · sunrise 07:19 · waxing crescent

pieces.title: Regarding the red pickup tailpipe
pieces.body: "The exhaust pipe only rattles when you idle at the gravel stop sign by the creamery. Once you shift into third gear and take the ridge road toward the lake, the wind takes the noise, the engine settles down, and you never hear a thing until you park."

pieces.title: Cellar wall whitewashed for root storage
pieces.body: The north stone wall of the cellar received two fresh coats of slaked lime whitewash yesterday afternoon. The bright mineral coating dries quickly in the dry autumn draft and leaves the storage bay smelling cleanly of wet stone and limestone. Silas brushed the mix deep into the mortar joints to discourage cellar mold before the squash crates arrive.
pieces.reason: masonry upkeep recorded in project log

pieces.title: Boiler circulation pump stirred before dawn
pieces.body: The hydronic heating controller ran its scheduled pre-season pump circulation test at five in the morning, spinning the brass impeller for ninety seconds to prevent seasonal scale seizure. Water pressure across the loop held steady at eighteen pounds, and no air knocks were recorded through the parlour floorboards. The system returned quietly to standby.

pieces.title: Firewood permit renewal pending inspection
pieces.body: The annual state forest firewood cutting permit expires in eight days, with two cords of storm blowdown still allotted to North Hollow. Silas plans to haul the small trailer up to the state access road once the soil dries from earlier showers. A sharp chainsaw chain and three spare bar nuts were set beside the mudroom boots.

pieces.title: a draft under the door
pieces.body: the cellar door let in four degrees of cool air while the lime bucket was carried down. the house noticed and closed the intake damper. someone dropped an iron washer behind the wood box. it made a small ringing sound. it is still there. there is no reason to move it until saturday.
